en.description:
One safe. One dial. A combination waiting to be discovered.

LockShift turns a safe's dial into a puzzle of observation, memory and precision. Listen for the click that confirms each number, change direction when needed and press TRY to attempt opening. Setting the combination is only part of the challenge: you decide when to try it.

FROM YOUR FIRST CLICK TO NEW ROUTES
Start with three tutorials available from the beginning. Learn to set one, two and three numbers, then complete the third tutorial to unlock Crossroads. Lessons introduce mechanics as they appear.

ON YOUR PHONE OR YOUR WRIST
Use the touch dial on iPhone or turn the Digital Crown on Apple Watch. The Watch game works independently of your iPhone. The game interface and lessons are in English.

ONE SEASON, ONE CHALLENGE EACH WEEK
The included season contains 26 different challenges, released on a shared calendar. The current challenge is free to play during its week. Future challenges stay locked until their release date, even with Premium. New weeks are not generated automatically when the season ends.

FREE AND PREMIUM
The three tutorials, Crossroads once unlocked and the current weekly challenge do not require Premium. Premium is a one-time in-app purchase to replay season challenges that have moved into the archive. It is not a subscription and does not open future challenges early.

YOUR OWN PERSONAL BESTS
Improve your time and track your personal records. PAR shows the number of moves in the shortest valid route; moves and mistakes are displayed separately. There are no online leaderboards.

PLAY OFFLINE
The included catalog and gameplay need no game server or separate account. Records are stored locally on each device, without syncing between iPhone and Apple Watch. Checking, buying or restoring Premium may require a connection to Apple.

Turn. Listen. Try.
en.subtitle: Crack the combination
